readings.moment: Dinner: when the temple struck nine, everyone was told to put their watches on the cloth
When the temple struck nine, Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine
Félix heard the temple strike ten while in the library
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door
A thump on the floor right above him, in the atelier
After the thump, the uncle's repeater struck ten (ten slow deep notes)
Someone came quickly down the stairs, past the library door
Bastien Girard came into the library
The temple struck eleven, when Girard and Félix were still sitting together in the library

durations: From 10:18 to 10:21 on Félix's watch: about 3 minutes (implied, the thump followed by someone coming down the stairs)
From 10:32 to 11:00 (Girard's arrival on Félix's watch until the temple struck eleven): 28 minutes, during which they sat together in the library
whereabouts: At dinner, Félix was at the table with the family when the temple struck nine
At dinner, the uncle went round the table inspecting the watches
At dinner, Girard laughed and Odile looked at her plate
After dinner, Félix went up to the library
In the library, Félix drank brandy, then more
Félix stayed alone in the library until Girard arrived
Félix was in the library, directly under the atelier bench, when the thump came
Félix heard someone go up the stairs past the library door at 10:15 but did not see who it was
Félix heard someone come down the stairs at 10:21 but did not see who it was
Félix stayed in the library after the thump and finished his brandy
The aunt was playing the piano downstairs when the thump came
Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32 and sat with Félix until the temple struck eleven
